name: Glassbox
mission: An interpretability lab Claude Code drives over MCP.
flowAlt: Data flow. The scientist: Claude Code runs the /investigate command, pre-registers each experiment with a quantitative prediction in a hash-chained notebook, then runs it and gets the prediction scored. The lab: an MCP server with ten tools calls lab primitives such as patching, ablation and probes, which run on one of four backends: local-full, local-4bit, local-gguf or ndif. The record: a recovered algorithm is checked on held-out inputs with agreement, causal and null-calibrated checks; it counts as verified only at full precision; a report is written whose claims must cite experiment ids.
